title: Mats, Rings and Strips
bigQuestion: Why do some sports need a mat, a ring or a strip instead of a field?

story.title: A Jacket by the Baseballs
story.kicker: A folded white jacket hangs next to a bag of baseballs.
paragraphs: A school hallway has a row of hooks. On one hook hangs a bag of baseballs. On the next hook hangs a folded white jacket with a belt.
The baseballs belong outside on a big field. The jacket belongs on a soft mat inside. Each thing points to a different room.
Some sports need a padded mat. Boxing needs a square called a ring. Fencing needs a long, thin strip. People made each room with rules.
In Illinois, school wrestlers have met on mats since the 1930s. Girls joined their own state finals in 2022. Each room has a story and a date.
story.think: What room at your school would fit each thing on the hooks?

lessons.title: Boys Wrestle for a Title
lessons.mainIdea: The IHSA held its first boys wrestling state finals in 1937.
reading: The *IHSA* began in 1900. It runs contests for high schools in Illinois. It writes rules so schools can play fair.
Wrestlers meet on a soft, padded *mat*. Illinois boys first wrestled for an IHSA state title in 1937.

words.d: the Illinois High School Association; it runs high school contests in Illinois
a soft, padded floor cover used for wrestling

look.prompt: Why would wrestlers need a soft floor?

check.q: When were the first IHSA boys wrestling champions?
check.why: The IHSA crowned its first boys wrestling champions in 1937.
A mat is a padded floor cover for wrestling.

lessons.title: Girls Get Their Own Finals
lessons.mainIdea: The IHSA held its first girls wrestling state finals in 2022.
reading: For many years, girls in Illinois had no wrestling state finals of their own. Some girls wrestled on boys teams.
The IHSA added girls wrestling as its own sport. The first girls state *finals* came in 2022, at the end of the 2021–22 season.

words.d: the last contest of a season, where champions are named

look.prompt: How many years passed between the boys and girls first finals?

check.why: The first girls state finals came in 2022, ending the 2021–22 season.

check.q: Before that, where did some girls wrestle?
check.why: Some girls wrestled on boys teams before girls had their own finals.

choices: the last contest where champions are named
check.why: Finals are the last contest of a season.

lessons.title: A Square Called a Ring
lessons.mainIdea: Boxing rules from 1867 asked for a square ring 24 feet wide.
reading: A boxing *ring* is really a square. Ropes go around its edges. The name ring is older than the square shape.
In 1867, rules named for the Marquess of Queensberry came out in Britain. They asked for a ring 24 feet across. They also said boxers must wear *gloves*.

words.d: the square place with ropes where boxing happens

look.title: The Size of the Ring
look.text: The match should be a fair stand-up boxing match in a 24-foot ring, or as near that size as can be.
look.prompt: What does this rule tell you about the room?

check.why: A boxing ring is a square with ropes.

check.q: When did the Queensberry Rules come out?
check.why: The Queensberry Rules came out in 1867.

check.q: What did the Queensberry Rules say boxers must wear?
check.why: The rules said boxers must wear gloves.

lessons.title: A Long Thin Strip
lessons.mainIdea: Fencing takes place on a long, narrow strip, and it was in the first modern Olympics.
reading: *Fencing* is a sport with thin, blunt swords. Fencers wear masks and white suits. Their contest happens on a long, narrow *strip*.
The strip is also called a piste. Fencing was part of the first modern Olympics in Athens, Greece, in 1896.

words.d: a sport with thin, blunt swords and masks
the long, narrow floor where fencing happens; also called a piste

check.why: Fencing happens on a long, narrow strip.

check.q: When was fencing in the first modern Olympics?
check.why: Fencing was in the first modern Olympics, Athens, 1896.

lessons.title: The Kodokan Opens
lessons.mainIdea: Kano Jigoro started the Kodokan, a judo school in Tokyo, in 1882.
reading: *Judo* comes from Japan. In 1882, Kano Jigoro opened a school for it in Tokyo. The school is called the *Kodokan*.
Kano was a teacher. He wanted judo taught in schools. Judo students wear a heavy cotton jacket and a belt. The color of the belt shows a rank.

words.d: a sport from Japan, started by Kano Jigoro
the judo school Kano Jigoro opened in Tokyo in 1882

lessons.title: Judo at the Olympics
lessons.mainIdea: Judo joined the Olympics in Tokyo in 1964, and women's judo joined in 1992.
reading: In 1964, the Olympics came to Tokyo, Japan. That year, judo became an Olympic sport. It was the first time for men.
Women's judo became a full Olympic sport later. That happened in 1992, in Barcelona, Spain.

words.d: a sport that has medals at the Olympics
